title: [RJ415569] SakuraSegment 0.3
description:
About This Game *IMPORTANT*

Single Map / Single Heroine
This is a prologue version that implements the basic system of the main game, which is currently under construction.
No story part, but casual exploratory action and over 8 Heroine hunts and Costumes each.

System
Casual action with the ability to switch between overlooking + first person view
Switch to First Person View to unlock hidden rooms and gimmicks!
It takes only 1 hour of play time to complete the full game!

Earn points!
Destroy enemies on the small aerial island and earn 3 types of points!
The 3 types of points are needed to use skills and to open costumes.
Open costumes at the stores scattered around the map!

Safe Area
There is one heroine in the safe area and you can hunt her!
You can select a costume from the bathhouse.
You can also use some skills on the heroine to perform special hunts.

Hunt Mode
Hunt mode is seamless.
The type of hunt mode depends on the heroine's position and condition
There are more than 8 types of hunt motions, including sneaking up behind her, attacking her to bring her down, binding her, and other skills.
The action part can be played with a gamepad (such as an Xbox controller)

Play Hint
If you get lost at the starting point, try attacking crystals and cracked walls with skills.

与僧侣交合的色欲之夜… / Souryo to Majiwaru Shikiyoku no Yoru ni… / 僧侶と交わる色欲の夜に… BDRip

这个项目与 **喵萌奶茶屋** 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in cooperation with **Nekomoe kissaten**. Thanks to them for elaborating Chinese subtitles.

此作为僧侣档开山之作，僧侣档也因其而得名。
This show is the first of the Souryo-Waku, for which it is named.

仅包含 R18 版本，不含 TV Ver. 和 CS Ver.
Includes R18 version only, no TV Ver. or CS Ver.

原盘画质较差。原生分辨率为 720p，线条有轻微的拉升带来的锯齿和振铃。虽然原盘的视频轨道码率为 34Mbps，但其中一半都是无用的 m2ts padding，我们 remux 之后发现其码率实际上是 17Mbps。低码率再加上制作时缺乏保护，导致平面随处可见非常严重的色带。我们的处理手段是逆向拉伸重构、去色带、补偿性锐化。最后加了一些噪点以尽量掩盖住残留的色带。
The source is of terrible quality, produced in native 720p. Lines feature slight aliasing and ringing caused by upscaling. The video tracks of the source seem to have a bitrate of 34Mbps, though half with useless m2ts padding, in fact 17Mbps after remux. Low bitrate plus the lack of image protection during production leads to terribly heavy colour banding everywhere in the flat area. Our PP: descaling and reconstruction, de-banding, compensatory sharpening and adding some grains in the end trying to cover the intractable colour banding.
